messages.author: e1bf8c9d37f8c1b4
messages.subject: Install problem
parts:
Hi All,

it seems all the three Windows binaries of devtools 1.5 available on CRAN are corrupted; installing is OK but while loading into R you get the message:

> require(devtools)
Loading required package: devtools
Error in get(Info[i, 1], envir = env) : lazy-load database 'P' is corrupt

Anyone else has had the same error message?

Cheers,
Nicola

messages.author: deea3c30b4c8409f
messages.subject: Re: Install problem
parts:
Hi,

this sometimes happens when you reinstall a package that is loaded.
(It is probably an R (base) bug.) So maybe this happens here, too.

I would first try these steps:
1. reinstall devtools (in case you have a corrupted installation)
2. restart R
3. load devtools.

Gabor
